headline: Claude Opus 5 Lands on Amazon Bedrock
summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5, matching Fable 5 intelligence, is now available on Amazon Bedrock, making frontier-quality agentic pipelines more accessible.
details: The first 5th-generation Opus, Claude Opus 5, became available on Amazon Bedrock on July 24. Anthropic claims it matches Fable 5 intelligence across agentic coding, knowledge work, visual understanding, and long-horizon tasks.

This availability changes the economics for enterprise-tier compute. While Fable 5 was powerful, its cost limited widespread adoption. Opus 5 offers comparable capability at a more practical price point, potentially making frontier-quality agentic pipelines feasible for more teams.

Key deployment details include Zero Data Retention, which is on by default. The model also runs on Bedrock's next-generation inference engine, providing lower latency compared to Anthropic-hosted deployments.

During its preview phase, Claude Opus 5 is free and offers up to 10 investigations per day per account. It auto-correlates findings across CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and DNS logs, returning risk levels, MITRE ATT&CK mappings, and remediation recommendations in minutes.
The model is available in 10 commercial AWS regions. Access is provided via MCP through the AWS Agent Toolkit, emphasizing its integration into existing AWS workflows.
